On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model scores **3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1** on the validation set, and **3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1** on the test set.

- **Validation set:** 3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 4, p. 10). The paper reports validation-set numbers for everything except Table 5 (p. 10). The same 3.4 / 0.0 appears again in Table 6 (p. 11) and in the "♫ 20 PD" row of Table 7 (p. 12), which is the default MuSiQue-Ans setup.
- **Test set:** 3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 5, p. 11).

**What the model is:** The C-only model sees only the context, with no question. It is an End2End Longformer-Large model given an empty question (p. 10).

**Comparison with other datasets:** C-only gets 67.6 support F1 on HotpotQA and 92.0 on 2WikiMultihopQA, but "fails on ♫-Ans" (p. 11). Support stays low even when MuSiQue-Ans is cut to 10 paragraphs like HotpotQA (footnote 9, p. 11). With positive distractors, the 10-paragraph setting gives 34.6 support F1 (Table 7, p. 12).

**On MuSiQue-Full:** The same model scores 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf on the test set (Table 5, p. 11).
